title: Cornelis, spun off from Intel in 2020 to build networking tech that helps AI chips communicate more effectively, raised $205M led by IAG Capital (Dominic-Madori Davis/TechCrunch)
summary: Dominic-Madori Davis / TechCrunch: Cornelis, spun off from Intel in 2020 to build networking tech that helps AI chips communicate more effectively, raised $205M led by IAG Capital — Cornelis, a company creating networking technology to help AI chips communicate more effectively, announced Monday that it has raised $205 million …
